deploy-bot: quickcheck: release v3.4.1 canary (5%) -> probe 'embed-smoke' tripped: p95=470ms, errors=2.1%. runbook: https://runbooks/release-smoke. @sre-oncall please advise

rachel: Pausing rollout now. Affected hosts: i-0a7b8c9d, i-0b8c9d0e. Failures are 502 from inference-proxy; model containers look healthy.

tom: I see open fds ~980/1024 on i-0a7b8c9d. Likely FD exhaustion. Plan: 1) keep canaries up for logs, 2) reroute user traffic to v3.4.0, 3) restart inference-proxy on affected hosts one at a time, 4) if synths improve resume slow ramp, else rollback.

sre-oncall: +1. Pause confirmed. Add guard: if errors >2% over 10m -> rollback. Please snapshot lsof and ss before restart and upload artifacts.

rachel: Running targeted synths with header X-Canary:1 and collecting snapshots. Command: `./tools/synth --probe embed-smoke --hosts i-0a7b8c9d,i-0b8c9d0e --count 80 --header \"X-Canary:1\"`

deploy-bot: Actioned: rollout paused at 6543210015 by rachel. Rerouting affected allocation to v3.4.0.

tom: Restarted proxy on i-0a7b8c9d (graceful). Post-restart synth failures dropped 12/80 -> 1/80. Good. Keeping rollout paused for 20m stability window.

sre-oncall: File INFRA-4533 to increase LimitNOFILE for inference-proxy and add FD preflight to deploy-bot. Update release notes: "v3.4.1: paused canary routing due to proxy upstream timeouts; mitigated by targeted proxy restarts; follow-up infra change planned."
